result.summary: The viewer, in a white shirt, makes a run into the box, receives a through ball, and scores with a shot over the goalkeeper.

observations.title: Initial Movement
observations.body: The viewer is positioned on the right side of the attacking third, already moving forward as the ball is played by a teammate in a dark kit.

observations.title: Run in Behind
observations.body: The viewer makes a direct run into the penalty area, getting behind the defensive line to receive a through pass. This creates a clear scoring opportunity.

observations.title: First Touch and Shot
observations.body: The viewer takes a single touch to control the ball inside the box, then immediately strikes it towards goal. The shot is taken quickly after the first touch.

observations.title: Goal Scored
observations.body: The shot goes over the outstretched arms of the goalkeeper and into the net, resulting in a goal. The viewer ends up on the ground after the effort.
